OWNER_IDS.description: Bootstrap owner IDs (comma-separated). They can manage MongoDB-backed admins and restart the bot.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI used to store administrators and persistent rename-task checkpoints

MONGO_DB_NAME.description: MongoDB database for this bot instance. Use a different name for every bot token sharing a cluster.

SESSION_STRING.description: Optional Telegram Premium user-session string for downloads above 2 GiB. Leave empty to use normal bot downloads.

ALLOWED_GROUP_IDS.description: Keep this as your Group chat ID where you will add the bot

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your bot token, as a string. Get this from @BotFather

DC.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram data centers (1-5) to allow; leave blank to allow all.

COMMAND_POSTFIX.description: Numeric suffix appended to every command; use 0 for no suffix, 2 for /rename2, etc.

DUMP_CHAT_ID.description: Optional Telegram dump chat used by the Premium user session for files above 2 GiB. Use a numeric chat ID, public username, or invite link.

BOT_DUMP_CHAT_ID.description: Bot-side dump chat for archived uploads. Use a numeric -100... ID or public @username; private invite URLs are not supported for the bot.

GL_LIMIT.description: Global maximum number of complete rename jobs admitted to the pipeline.

DL_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of downloads running concurrently.

UL_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of uploads running concurrently.

WM_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of watermark processing jobs running concurrently.
